feeds.title: Sylva Spoon Blog
feeds.description: I started turning wood into objects for use while living in South Korea. I think trees, woodlands and forests are fantastic things. Trees are best left living, but saving cut trees from becoming firewood allows me to give them a new lease on life. Helping people engage with the nature in new ways is the best use of where my skills and passions intersect.

feeds.title: The Spoon Crank Blog
feeds.description: Features spoon carving stories, spoon designs, inspiration, and tools. The spoon crank is an initiative looking to bring together people who share a passion for spoon carving.

feeds.title: Peter Follansbee Joiner's Notes
feeds.description: I make reproductions of 17th-century joined furniture; boxes, chests, chairs, tables & more. My work follows techniques and methods from the period, all work is done exclusively with hand-tools. Oak is the primary timber used, pine, maple and ash are also used to a lesser degree.

feeds.title: Barn the Spoon Blog
